title: Axiomatic Equilibrium Selection: The Case of Generic Extensive Form Games
abstract: arXiv:2504.16908v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A solution concept that is a refinement of Nash equilibria selects for each finite game a nonempty collection of closed and connected subsets of Nash equilibria as solutions. We impose three axioms for such solution concepts. The axiom of backward induction requires each solution to contain a quasi-perfect equilibrium. Two invariance axioms posit that solutions of a game are the same as those of a game obtained by the addition of strategically irrelevant strategies and players. Stability satisfies these axioms; and any solution concept that satisfies them must, for generic extensive-form games, select from among its stable outcomes. A strengthening of the two invariance axioms provides an analogous axiomatization of components of equilibria with a nonzero index.

translated_title: 公理化均衡选择：一般扩展型博弈的情形
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2504.16908v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：一种作为纳什均衡细化的解概念，为每个有限博弈选择一组非空的、闭且连通的纳什均衡子集作为解。我们对此类解概念施加三个公理。逆向归纳公理要求每个解包含一个准完美均衡。两个不变性公理则指出，一个博弈的解与通过添加策略无关的策略和玩家而得到的博弈的解相同。稳定性满足这些公理；任何满足这些公理的解概念，对于一般扩展型博弈，必须从其稳定结果中进行选择。对两个不变性公理的加强提供了对具有非零指数的均衡分量的类似公理化。
tldr: 本文通过三个公理（逆向归纳和两个不变性）公理化地刻画了稳定性，证明对于一般扩展型博弈，任何满足这些公理的解概念必须从稳定结果中选择，并扩展至非零指数均衡分量的公理化。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatizes stability via three axioms (backward induction and two invariance properties), showing that for generic extensive-form games, any solution concept satisfying them must select from stable outcomes, with a strengthened version yielding an axiomatization of equilibrium components with nonzero index.
